items.claim: Gillian Robertson is a nastier grappler than Mackenzie Dern.
items.quote: I just think she's a much nastier grappler than Mackenzie Dern.

items.claim: Ian Garry has no KO or finishing threat.
items.quote: there is no KO or finishing threat from Garry.

items.claim: Ian Garry's last finish was back in 2022 against Daniel Rodriguez.
items.quote: The last finish this guy had, I think, was back in 2022 [music] against Daniel Rodriguez.

items.claim: Ian Garry got outgrappled and outstruck by Shavkat Rakhmonov.
items.quote: The one decent grappler that Garry's faced in in Shavkat Rakhmonov, he got outgrappled, but like he also got outstruck by.

items.claim: Ian Garry is taller, rangier, and bigger than any opponent Islam Makhachev has faced before.
items.quote: Ian is so much more rangier and bigger than any Makhachev opponent.

items.claim: Ian Garry has elite fight IQ and some of the best striking in the game.
items.quote: he's got elite fight IQ, some of the best in the game. His striking is elite

items.claim: Ian Garry is the only guy to take Shavkat Rakhmonov to a decision.
items.quote: That's the only guy to take Shavkat to a decision.

items.claim: Islam Makhachev went 25 minutes against Alexander Volkanovski and won.
items.quote: This guy has gone 25 minutes against Alexander Volkanovski and beat him.

items.claim: Islam Makhachev knocked out Alexander Volkanovski in their second fight.
items.quote: he knocked him out in the second fight as well.
